tools.name: artlist-describe
tools.description: Call this first. Explains record types, public fields, how records link to each other, languages, record counts and how to search well.

tools.name: artlist-search
tools.description: Find artists, theorists, groups, spaces, artworks, videos, annotations, events and contributors (annotation authors). Combine free text (accent-insensitive, all words must match, "quotes" for a phrase) with filters: types, lang, year range (overlap), topics, place, related_to. Returns short records

tools.name: artlist-get
tools.description: Full public record by id (or page url): all public fields (biography, exhibitions, bibliography, technique, annotations …), every linked record grouped by type (id, type, name, years), and the other language versions. Long texts are cut at 5000 chars unless full=true; images only as image_count unle

tools.name: artlist-related
tools.description: Records connected to a record. via="topics": most similar records by shared topics (returns shared_topics). via="links" (default), depth=1: direct links (an artist's works, groups, videos; a group's members). depth=2: records connected through a shared neighbour (e.g. artists sharing a group or an a

tools.name: artlist-facets
tools.description: Record counts per type and language, and the most used topics; with type: distribution by decade, its topics and the most common places (birth places of persons, cities of spaces). Good for overviews and for choosing filters.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Standard document search over the Artlist archive of Czech contemporary art (artists, theorists, groups, spaces, artworks, videos, events, contributors), both languages. Returns ids for fetch. For filters (type, years, topics, links) prefer artlist-search.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Full text of one Artlist record by id from search: all public fields, linked records, annotations, with the page URL for citation.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: artlist-search, artlist-get, fetch · Private data: artlist-describe, artlist-search, artlist-get, artlist-related, artlist-facets, search, fetch · Public sink: artlist-related.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: artlist-search, artlist-get, fetch · Private data: artlist-describe, artlist-search, artlist-get, artlist-related, artlist-facets, search, fetch · Public sink: artlist-related

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
